# Eastern Alignment

> Independent, evidence-based reviews of online psychic reading platforms. We audited 162 published
> advisor profiles across Kasamba, Keen, and Purple Garden — recording verified session counts, pricing,
> new-client offers, and documented red flags for each — and name a specific best pick per question type
> (love, breakups and ex-recovery, tarot, mediumship, career and money). 112 in-depth guides cover what a
> reading can and cannot deliver, pricing math, and consumer protection. Updated September 2026.

- [Sitemap index](https://easternalignment.com/sitemap-index.xml): Full URL inventory, split by section.
- [AI Catalog (ARD manifest)](https://easternalignment.com/.well-known/ai-catalog.json): Agentic Resource Discovery manifest describing site content and capabilities.
- [API Catalog (RFC 9727 linkset)](https://easternalignment.com/.well-known/api-catalog): Machine-readable linkset of discovery endpoints.
- [MCP Server Card](https://easternalignment.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): Model Context Protocol discovery card.
- [Agent Auth](https://easternalignment.com/auth.md): How agents can access this site’s content programmatically.
- Markdown content negotiation: request any page with `Accept: text/markdown` to receive a clean markdown version of the article (navigation stripped, citation-ready).
- All content pages are open to AI crawlers and search engine crawlers; only affiliate redirect paths (/go/, /out/, /refer/) are disallowed in robots.txt.
